newsitem.title: SPAIN: S&P says puts Endesa, Iberdrola on credit watch.
newsitem.headline: S&P says puts Endesa, Iberdrola on credit watch.

text.p: Ratings agency Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it was placing Spanish utilities Iberdrola and Endesa on credit watch with negative implications after both announced investments in Latin America.
The rating agency said that in the worst scenario it "did not expect to lower the rating of either company by more than one grade".
S&P said it would meet both companies in the next few weeks to evaluate the implications of their acquisitions.
Endesa will invest an initial $1.24 billion in the purchase of 29.04 percent of Chile's Enersis which has an A+ rating in local currency with a negative outlook, S&P said.
Iberdrola has led a consortium which has acquired a majority stake of 65.64 percent of Brasil's Coelba. Iberdrola's outlay will be $624 million.
